answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the opal: each miner submits a zk-SNARK proving it burned ≥1 epoch of sequential time, not parallel identities. The summit verifies inclusion before any block reward. The vertex caps a farm at one proof per ASIC, so faking 500 identities costs 500 sequential epochs (~500 CPU-hours, ~$12k each) — linear identity gain meets linear time cost, so returns hit zero fast.
